description: This Java source file defines the DashboardService class, which provides methods to retrieve aggregated dashboard metrics such as defect severity distribution, overdue corrective actions, and defect trends over days. It interacts with repositories for defects and corrective actions, and includes methods annotated for transactional read-only operations.

classes.name: DashboardService
classes.description: Service class providing methods for dashboard metrics aggregation related to defects and corrective actions.

methods.name: severityDistribution
methods.description: Returns a distribution of defects across different severity levels.

methods.name: overdueActions
methods.description: Returns the count of overdue corrective actions.

methods.name: defectTrendLastDays
methods.description: Provides a trend of defects over the last specified number of days, grouped by day.
